text:
Priya (Finance): Hey team — noticed a promo credit applied to the March AWS Marketplace invoice for ResellerCo that looks larger than the agreed monthly cap. Can someone confirm eligibility?
Luca (Sales): Thanks for flagging. Which invoice line? ResellerCo had a short promo running in Feb that was supposed to only apply to first 3 months up to $5k/mo.
Priya (Finance): Invoice line 3421 and credit adj 3421-CR. Summary CSV snippet pasted below.
Marta (Billing): I pulled the invoice, see the credit id: PROMO-RESELLER-MAR-2026. Looks like it applied across both marketplace SKU and channel-seat SKU.
Jordan (PartnerOps): @Marta can you paste the raw usage/credit rows? I want to check partner ID mapping.
Marta (Billing): Sure — raw CSV view:
```
invoice_id,sku,partner_id,charge,credit,net
INV-2026-03-77,redwood.marketplace.generation,PART-789,12000,6000,6000
INV-2026-03-77,redwood.channel.seats,PART-789,3000,3000,0
```
Marta (Billing): The promo credit appears as two separate credit lines (6000 + 3000) — total 9k.
Luca (Sales): That 3k for seats shouldn't have been eligible — promo only targeted marketplace consumption not seats. We sent an eligibility file to Marketplace team when promo was created.
Priya (Finance): Can we revert the 3k credit and apply only the 5k cap? Customer is asking for detailed breakdown for their accounting team.
Alex (Revenue Ops): Quick check: contract says "promo cap $5,000/month per partner" and excludes seat SKUs. If we mistakenly applied to seat sku we should create a negative credit reversal and reissue corrected invoice.
FinanceBot: Note: Automated rule PROMO-APPLY-2026 matched partner tags and marketplace SKUs; rule scope includes tag "reseller_promo".
Jordan (PartnerOps): It may be that partner tagging was duplicated across seat sku metadata. I'll run a tag audit. ETA 2 hours.
Marta (Billing): Action plan: 1) Create reversal credit for PROMO-RESELLER-MAR-2026-seat of 3000, 2) Recompute invoice totals and issue corrected invoice PDF, 3) Notify reseller and Sales.
Priya (Finance): Please include GL impact and revenue recognition note. We need the reversal accounted in March close.
Luca (Sales): I'll prep a short note to ResellerCo apologizing and explaining corrected invoice; CC Jordan and Marta.
Alex (Revenue Ops): If reversal hits March revenue, confirm whether we need a journal entry for deferred revenue adjustment. I'll coordinate with accounting.
Jordan (PartnerOps): Tag audit results: seat sku had tag "reseller_promo" on 2026-02-14 due to import script mapping error. I'll push a fix and list affected partners in the audit doc.
Marta (Billing): Reversal draft: credit id REV-2026-03-77-1 amount 3000, reason "promo ineligible SKU". I'll queue it and hold for approvals.
Priya (Finance): Approve the reversal once Alex confirms GL treatment. 
Alex (Revenue Ops): Approved pending accounting entry. I'll send the JE details by EOD.
Marta (Billing): Noted. I'll also attach corrected invoice numbers to the ticket and set a customer-facing explanation template.
Luca (Sales): Thanks — once invoice is reissued I'll follow up with ResellerCo to ensure they can reconcile. :thumbsup:
Priya (Finance): Great. Jordan — please drop the audit CSV in this thread when ready.
Jordan (PartnerOps): Will do.
Priya (Finance): Closing note: this looks like low-risk operational error, but let's add a regression test to marketingsync import to prevent tag bleed onto seat SKUs.
Luca (Sales): Agreed. I'll add the test to the promo rollout checklist.
Marta (Billing): Reversal queued, awaiting Alex JE. I'll post invoice diff when done.
FinanceBot: Reminder: billing change will trigger downstream webhook to accounting-prod; ensure no duplicate hooks during rollback.
Priya (Finance): Thanks everyone — keep updates short here.
Jordan (PartnerOps): Audit CSV attached in thread (uploaded).
Marta (Billing): Corrected invoice issued INV-2026-03-77-R1, credit REV-2026-03-77-1 applied. Sent notice to ResellerCo.
Luca (Sales): Confirmed ResellerCo received corrected invoice and is good. Closing. :white_check_mark:
